model_annotation: The chart is a horizontal bar chart illustrating the number of participants associated with different evaluation criteria. The category axis is vertical and labeled “Criterion,” listing (from top to bottom) “Relevant FCs,” “FC Summary,” “R,” “Clarity and Simplicity,” “Overall Summary,” “Filters,” and “Veracity Explanation.” The value axis is horizontal and labeled “Number of Participants,” shown on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0, 2, 4, and 6. Each criterion is represented by a single solid-colored bar with a numeric value label at the bar end: “Relevant FCs” has a dark purple bar reaching 6, “FC Summary” has a dark blue bar reaching 5, “R” has a blue-green bar reaching 3, “Clarity and Simplicity” has a teal/green bar reaching 3, “Overall Summary” has a green bar reaching 2, “Filters” has a light green bar reaching 1, and “Veracity Explanation” has a yellow-green bar reaching 1. The bars appear ordered from larger to smaller values from top to bottom, and there are no grouped/stacked segments, legend entries, or additional visual emphasis beyond the end-of-bar value annotations.
